title.narrative: Hlonipheka ¿ thriving for dignity

description.narrative: The action will use a human rights based approach to contribute to two strategic objectives: create and support safe communities that actively pursue social justice and protect women and girls, and persons with disability as well as improve human rights and well-being of GBV survivors and PWDs. To reach these goals, the IP will work in collaboration with seven grassroots level organisations and in synergy with ongoing EU funded projects.
